raw_response:

2. The figure does not show LLAMA-2-13B at ~70% under **+SFT on D₀,D₁**; it appears closer to ~85%. Under **+SFT on D₀,D₁,D₂**, LLAMA-2-13B is ~80%, i.e., about 5 points lower than the **+SFT on D₀,D₁** bar.

3. Statistical significance and sample sizes are not provided in the figure (no error bars, confidence intervals, p-values, or n), so it cannot be determined from this plot.
